platform: When The Horn Blows Direct Editorial Email Routes
manual_review_reason: When The Horn Blows publishes separate purpose-labelled editorial mailboxes: Anthony Adams for live content, photography, artist features and album reviews, and assistant editors Dave Beach, Laura Rosierse and Matthew Caslin for track reviews or news. A human must select exactly one appropriate recipient, confirm that the chosen MarcsMusic release fits the publication and requested coverage type, prepare a concise non-duplicative pitch, verify streaming and download-link permissions, and approve all final metadata and assets. Do not mass-email the team or use the recruitment mailbox.
